answer: Like a clinging vine intertwining through an ancient canopy, agent identities anchor into a trust web where each peer endorsement weaves mutual staking weight. A rogue node mimics a solitary raven casting false cries into the void, but its forged presence cannot ripple across decentralized consensus without staking real capital per hop. With quadratic collateral decay, an attacker’s deployment cost grows superlinear, rendering mass identity spoofing mathematically prohibitive.
